🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-27 23:00 → 2026-10-28 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Verdict binding proposed** — a concrete field list tying signed verdicts to chain ID, escrow address, job ID, deliverable hash and the agreed schema landed in the agentic commerce thread. [ERC-8183 reply](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/437)

> **Anchor log went live** — the day-partitioned anchoring service is running on the pinned commit and writing one file per UTC day. [tg:tawg:5900]

> **Evaluator side sharpened** — the thread worked through what a provider's hash commitment over the exact served bytes actually lets an evaluator check. [ERC-8183 post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/436)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### ERC-8183

_The evaluator and signing details moved from open questions toward a concrete, replay-resistant shape._

- teppi-xyz **Sharpened** the evaluator side by pressing on what a provider's keccak256 commitment over the exact bytes served really lets a verifier check, which keeps agentic commerce settlement grounded in evidence rather than trust. [ERC-8183 post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/436)
- ted0x **Proposed** binding the signed verdict to chain ID, escrow address, job ID, deliverable hash and the agreed schema, so a verdict carries its own context and cannot be quietly reused in another job — the kind of guardrail agents need when they settle work across chains. [ERC-8183 reply](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/437)

### anchor-log

_Infrastructure moved from pull-request intent to a running service._

- Baby Blue Viper **Shipped** the anchor-log service on the pinned commit 1fe5fb29104d, live and writing one file per UTC day as described in the pull request, giving the group a date-addressable record surface to build settlement checks against. [tg:tawg:5900]

### zkIE

_Identity work is heading into a fresh revision._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Kicked off** a zkIE update, moving the identity component into a new revision cycle so it stays in step with the settlement work around it. [tg:tawg:5897]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Whether the delivery hash commitment and the verdict binding fields belong in the ERC text itself, rather than only in thread replies.
- Whether the one-file-per-UTC-day layout should become the reference shape for other settlement logs.

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Smoke-test the live anchor-log endpoint against the per-day file layout from the pull request, and confirm the service is still on the pinned commit.
- Fold the verdict-binding proposal into the ERC-8183 draft so implementers find it without reading the whole thread.
- Check in on zkIE once the update lands, and see whether any interface other TAWG work depends on shifts.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** a question about what an evaluator can verify turned into a concrete list of fields a signed verdict should bind to within the same day.
>
> That is a spec thread converting a worry into a checklist before lunch — keep that rhythm going, one careful clause at a time 🧾
